adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
adds.text: After Creel turns up as Talbot's reformed bodyguard, Fitz and Simmons visit him in his containment module to learn how he survived touching the Obelisk.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Engineer who visits Creel's containment module with Simmons.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Talbot's reformed bodyguard, whom Fitz visits in containment.
adds.evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): Creel, freed of Hydra's conditioning and working as Talbot's bodyguard, is held in a containment module at the Playground, where Fitz and Simmons visit and question him; he then joins the mission and helps rescue Coulson and Talbot.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
adds.text: May takes Creel for a Hydra killer stalking Talbot and hits him with a pipe so Lincoln can bring him down, only to learn he is Talbot's reformed bodyguard. He then fights Hydra alongside her team at the symposium.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who brings Creel down, then fights beside him against Hydra.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Talbot's reformed bodyguard. May takes him down before learning the truth.
adds.evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): May spots Creel trailing Talbot, ambushes him with a metal pipe so Lincoln can electrocute him; Talbot reveals Creel is his bodyguard. Creel later rescues Coulson and Talbot and fights Hydra with the team.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
adds.text: When Daisy comes back to the base freed from Hive, she tells Talbot that Lash is dead, and Talbot wonders whether her return is a trick.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: ATCU head who doubts Daisy's return from Hive is real.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Agent who returns from Hive's control and briefs Talbot.
adds.evidence: Emancipation (S3#20): Daisy returns to the Playground after Lash frees her, tells Talbot Lash was killed; Talbot questions whether it is a trick while Simmons treats her.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#2
adds.text: Daisy holds the Monolith's portal open with her powers until her nose bleeds, long enough for Fitz to pull Jemma back from the alien planet.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend Daisy holds the portal open to bring home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Best friend who holds the portal open to bring Jemma home.
adds.evidence: Purpose in the Machine (S3#2): Daisy's vibrational powers keep the Monolith portal open at the English castle until it explodes; Fitz goes through and returns with Simmons.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#6
adds.text: Daisy, Hunter and Mack chase down Luther Banks, whom they suspect is Lash, take his blood and spy on the ATCU facility he was headed to.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teammate who helps Daisy chase down Banks as a Lash suspect.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Teammate who hunts Banks with Hunter and Mack.
adds.evidence: Among Us Hide... (S3#6): with no assignment, Hunter joins Daisy and Mack; they I.C.E.R. Banks, take a blood sample and send a camera into the ATCU facility.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18
adds.text: Under Hive's sway, Daisy confronts Fitz in Bucharest and chokes him with her powers to warn him she does not want to be rescued.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend Daisy chokes in Bucharest while under Hive's sway.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend who, under Hive's sway, chokes Fitz as a warning.
adds.evidence: The Singularity (S3#18): Hive and Daisy go to Bucharest; Daisy uses her powers on Fitz, choking him, to say she does not want to be rescued and that there will be no other warning.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22
adds.text: May and Fitz sneak aboard Zephyr One and free Daisy after Hive takes her captive.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's trainer, who sneaks aboard Zephyr One to free her from Hive.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee, freed by May from Hive aboard Zephyr One.
adds.evidence: Ascension (S3#22): Hive captures Daisy and takes her aboard Zephyr One; May and Fitz secretly board the plane and find and free her.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#21
adds.text: Coulson visits Daisy in containment as she comes off Hive's hold. She calls herself a brainwashed criminal like Ward, and he puts it down to withdrawal.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's father figure, who refuses to see her as a criminal.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, who blames herself for serving Hive.
adds.evidence: Absolution (S3#21): in the Playground, Coulson updates Daisy in her containment module; she says she is no better than Grant Ward, a brainwashed criminal, and Coulson dismisses it as withdrawal from her addiction.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
adds.text: Simmons briefs Talbot on Hive's plans and, while he watches, confirms that Daisy is free of Hive's control.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist who briefs Talbot on Hive and clears Daisy.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: General whom Jemma briefs on Hive's plans.
adds.evidence: Emancipation (S3#20): in Coulson's office Simmons explains to Talbot that Hive has the Kree blood and Terrigen he needs; later Talbot watches Simmons treat Daisy and she confirms Daisy is safe.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
adds.text: Hunter clashes with Talbot over bringing Carl Creel, the man who killed his friends, on the mission, while Talbot insists Creel is reformed.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mercenary who fights Talbot over trusting Creel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: General who defends bringing Creel along.
adds.evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): at the Playground Talbot clashes with Hunter, who despises Creel for the deaths of Isabelle Hartley and Idaho; Talbot says it was Whitehall's brainwashing.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
adds.text: May jumps Carl Creel when she thinks he is after Talbot, then finds Talbot's kidnapped son so the team can get him out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who finds Talbot's kidnapped son.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: General whose kidnapped son May finds.
adds.evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): May and Lincoln bring down Creel thinking he targets Talbot; at the symposium May locates George Talbot in suspension gel and the group escapes with him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
adds.text: Ward has Jemma tortured at his castle so Fitz will tell him how she came back through the Monolith.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend Ward has tortured to make Fitz talk.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra traitor who has Jemma tortured to break Fitz.
adds.evidence: Closure (S3#9): Giyera captures Fitz and Simmons and, at the Hydra castle, tortures Simmons so that Ward can learn from Fitz how she returned from the planet.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#4
adds.text: Hunter, sent to kill Ward, finds him leading the new Hydra and refuses his deal to spare Andrew Garner, shooting Ward as he escapes.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mercenary sent to kill Ward, who shoots him as he flees.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra's new leader, whom Hunter shoots as he escapes.
adds.evidence: Devils You Know (S3#4): Kebo introduces Hunter to Hydra's 'Director', Ward; Hunter rejects Ward's offer to spare Garner and keeps attacking, hitting Ward as he flees.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#4
adds.text: When May backs up Hunter against Ward, Ward threatens to have Andrew Garner killed unless they let him go, and May is ready to back off to save him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bitter enemy who will let Ward go to save Garner.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Bitter enemy who threatens May's ex-husband to escape.
adds.evidence: Devils You Know (S3#4): May arrives as Hunter's backup; Ward reveals Strucker is stalking Garner and will kill him unless they let Ward escape; May protests when Hunter refuses.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
adds.text: When Hunter and Bobbi have to leave S.H.I.E.L.D., Jemma sends them the first drink across a bar in a silent spy's goodbye.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who says goodbye to Jemma with a drink across a bar.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who sends Hunter a farewell drink across a bar.
adds.evidence: Parting Shot (S3#13): at a bar, a waitress brings Hunter and Morse a shot from a 'secret admirer'; they see Simmons, who cannot speak to them because of a spy, and the rest of the team follows.
